title: Cosmere World-Hoppers
description: This pack is a collection of all the Cosmere Mods made by leafreynolds with what i consider modpack essentials like performance and quality of life mods.
body: This modpack blends the magical depth of Brandon Sanderson's *Cosmere* universe with the limitless creativity of Minecraft, featuring 8 core mods by leafyreynolds alongside 28 complementary additions for a total of 36 mods. Expect top notch magic systems, unique weapons, and immersive lore that transforms vanilla gameplay into an epic journey.
